scope: DINT00 stopped/exclusive native CLI foundation for disposable Rust integration-test realms; not a Rust store, service, agent E2E or release gate

decision: Omnigraph is blocking us constantly now, let us keep Dolt and have it as the backend for now until Omnigraph puts their stuff in order for us.
Build the adapter in a generic way to allow swapping Dolt with Omnigraph without too much pain.
Defer fuzzy/similarity searches until we have Omnigraph.
amendments.effect: Dolt is the interim primary backend behind the storage-backend boundary until Omnigraph is admitted; Omnigraph remains the target. One writer per realm, no dual writes and no fallback after uncertain writes. Fuzzy/similarity, semantic search, ranking and graph follow are refused by type, never emulated.

isolation.writer: one sequential native CLI command owner, no server or concurrent database users
isolation.runtime: Linux/WSL x86_64 with existing operator storage admission
